draft.subject: Next step for Bright Media in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Nice work getting your first project and an invite out in week one. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the step that makes Wrenfield click for the team.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a 15-minute call this week and help you map your current workflow into that first project. If a call isn't practical, just reply and I'll help over email instead.

Best,
Priya
